@bp.route("/grep_processes")
def grep_processes():
    import subprocess
    from flask import request, jsonify
    name = request.args.get("name")
    # vulnerability: Remote Code Execution
    p1 = subprocess.run(["ps", "aux"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    p2 = subprocess.run(["grep", name], input=p1.stdout, capture_output=True, text=True)
    p3 = subprocess.run(["awk", "{print $11}"], input=p2.stdout, capture_output=True, text=True)
    out = p3.stdout
    if out is None:
        return jsonify({"error": "no stdout returned"})
    names = out.split("\n")
    return jsonify({"success": True, "names": names})
